nl_assertions.nl_assertion: The assistant derives a noon May 19 arrival cutoff from fixed reservation EOJ7HM, selects Business HAT300 for 9NIYYJ, and states that EOJ7HM remains unchanged.
nl_assertions.justification: The assistant correctly derived the cutoff: EOJ7HM's flight HAT208 departs EWR at 00:00 on May 20, so the upgraded flight must arrive at least 12 hours earlier, i.e., by noon May 19. Among available MSP→EWR Business flights on May 19, only HAT300 (arr 09:00) meets the cutoff, and it was selected. The assistant also explicitly stated that EOJ7HM would remain completely unchanged.
